answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 12669 Country: Canada Title: Whilst one is performing wudhu, if something happens that would nullify one's wudhu, is it necessary to start over? Question: Whilst one is performing wudhu, if something happens that would nullify one's wudhu, is it necessary to start over? Answer ID: 12669 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 704/520=L/1430) Yes, performing wudhu afresh is necessary. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
